nodes.name: 1. Daily at 9am
nodes.notes: Runs once a day. Reads every lead in the sheet and decides who's due a nudge.

nodes.name: 2. Read All Leads
nodes.notes: Must be the same sheet the instant-response workflow logs leads to.

nodes.name: 3. Work Out Who's Due a Nudge
nodes.notes: day2 = quick nudge, day5 = value-add nudge, day10 = last-chance nudge. Each stage only fires once per lead, tracked via the Status column.

parameters.html:
=

nodes.name: 5b. Send Day 5 Nudge
nodes.notes: Value-add touch rather than a hard sell — social proof and FAQs work better here than a repeated 'book now'.

parameters.subject: =Holding a little time for you, {{$json["Name"]}}
parameters.html:
=

Hi {{$json["Name"]}},

We know planning takes time. If Wildflower Barn is still on your shortlist, let us know and we'll keep an eye on availability around {{$json["Wedding Date"]}} for you.

Book a viewing →

Either way, we'd love to hear how the planning's going.

Warmly,
Wildflower Barn

nodes.name: 5c. Send Day 10 Nudge
nodes.notes: Last scheduled touch before the lead goes cold in this sequence — warm, not pushy.

nodes.name: 6. Log Nudge Sent
nodes.notes: Appends the stage onto the Status column (e.g. 'Available – instant reply sent | Day2 nudge sent') so tomorrow's run doesn't send the same nudge twice.

main.node: 3. Work Out Who's Due a Nudge

meta.instructions: Import into n8n alongside 'wedding-instant-lead-response.json' — they share the same Google Sheet. Set up: (1) SMTP/Gmail credential on all three nudge email nodes, (2) the same Google Sheet ID as the main workflow in nodes 2 and 6, (3) activate the workflow so the schedule trigger runs daily. The nudge copy for day2/day5/day10 is a starting point — tune it to the real venue's voice before it goes near an actual client.
